subtitle: An Unofficial Field Study on the Slight Alterations Caused by One Particular Person
opened: An ordinary afternoon (it did not stay one)
handling: Read slowly. Preferably somewhere with a window.
slipNote: Names appear on this slip only. Inside, you are simply *you*, and occasionally *the subject*. You'll know which one is the compliment.
tocFoot: Pages are numbered for the archive. The subject is not numbered. Attempts were made.

figs.laugh: Propagation of one laugh across an ordinary room. Not to scale. Nothing about it was to scale.
figs.grid: Local distortion of meaning in the vicinity of the subject.
figs.flight: Two ways of looking at a horizon.
figs.experiment: Liveliness of one ordinary day, two conditions. Both lines are alive. One is more so.

lines: You did not move a single coordinate.
You changed what the coordinates mean.
Some people look at the horizon and admire it.
You look at it and start planning a route.

photoNote: Not attached. Every exposure came out slightly brighter than the room actually was.
indexIntro: Readings taken across a range of ordinary conditions, before and after the subject entered them. Higher is more alive. The instrument has been recalibrated twice since it met you. Neither attempt held.
indexFoot: ™ The World Difference Index is not registered anywhere. It is barely registered here. Readings above 10 are not supposed to happen and have been reported to no one.
appendixNote: Found folded inside the back cover of Case File 0001. Pencil. Not to be entered as evidence.
finalLines: Some people don’t change the world.
They simply change the way you notice it.
